description: We are a one-person team. I'm an automation developer who builds web applications with AI-assisted tools. For the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, I will build a browser-based game where kids aged 7-12 run a base on Mars and learn real engineering trade-offs by playing, grounded in NASA open data. Like a commander's logbook, every sol of the mission is recorded. We are not looking for new members at this time.
